name: run_postgres_select_query
description: Executes a read-only SELECT query against a Postgres service. The query is routed through the Postgres query endpoint with the read-only role and only read-style statements are permitted.

database.description: Postgres database to run the query in. Omit to use the postgres database.

organizationId.description: Organization that owns the Postgres service. Use the id of an organization returned by get_organizations.

query.description: SQL to run on the Postgres service. It executes under a read-only role, so only read statements succeed. Results come back as JSON rows with column metadata.

serviceId.description: Managed Postgres service to run the query on. Use the id of a postgres-type service returned by get_services_list.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for the query before the call returns a timeout error. Omit to use the server default of 300 seconds.
